summary: Diff implements mobile-safe chat layout: ChatPanel is now a flex column card with an internal ScrollArea for messages (min-h-0/overflow-hidden) and a fixed composer section; message text uses wrapping/break utilities; attached images and image previews are constrained to max width; ChatPage and CalendarMonthPage wrap ChatPanel in 100dvh-based height containers to avoid nested overflow.

hallucinated_features.description: Upload progress UI and progress-tracking state for image uploads ("Uploading: {uploadProgress}%") added to the main composer and reply composer.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest focuses on overflow/scrolling/wrapping/responsive images and container height; it explicitly lists non-goals as not adding new chat features. Upload progress feedback is a new UX feature not requested.
